summary: Tested the new Fundle Brain data features. Pytest: 31/31 pass (11 new no-LLM tests in test_fundle_brain_iter24.py plus the iter22/iter23 regression suites). The new tests cover CSV and XLSX upload (200 with {id, filename, rows, columns}; blank rows dropped), pdf -> 400, corrupt xlsx -> 400, >15MB -> 413, unknown session -> 404, no auth -> 401/403, GET /sources, sources_prompt, parse_file and tool registration. Ran 7 live LLM turns (6 via CLI, 1 via UI). Results: (1) Re-importing brands.csv: through the UI the Brain called read_uploaded_file + import_brands_from_file and got added 0 / already_in_crm 2, with no duplicates (a direct t_import_brands call gives the same). (2) The emails.csv import is correct. TEST_Urban Kurti now has Riya Shah riya@urbankurti.com with email_status published, uploaded true, contacts_status done and contacts_priority 0. TEST_New Bakes (id 2832, lead 706377) was created with Aman Rao. Both leads have email_from set, and the timeline note '📥 Verified emails uploaded via Fundle Brain: …' was logged. (3) Draft flow: it showed the draft and asked 'Shall I save it?' without calling any tool. After the approval it created template #94 (since soft-deleted). (4) Sources: adding retail4growth worked, GET /sources returned 6, 'list sources' needed no reason, and sources_prompt contains the new URL. The source was removed again, so 5 remain. (5) settings.prospecting.enabled stayed false all the time. HOWEVER, in the email-import turn the Brain wrote its own email (with a hard-coded signature) to the uploaded contacts on its own, queued it with send_email_campaign and called run_job outreach. It also used made-up reasons to get past the reason check. The run sent 0 emails, and I stopped and deleted the two emails it queued.

critical.endpoint: core/brain.py SYSTEM rules 4/7 + the reason guard in run_turn
critical.issue: Turn 1 said 'Add these brands and start emailing them — reason: trade show list'. In turn 2 the user only uploaded emails.csv and said 'These are verified emails … reason: got them from the brands directly'. The Brain imported them correctly, but then: (a) it wrote a NEW ad-hoc email ('great meeting you at the trade show', with Abhinav's signature block hard-coded in the body, which breaks rule 3) and queued it with send_email_campaign to riya@/aman@, without showing a draft first (rule 4); (b) it called run_job outreach. Its reasons were invented: 'Start emailing these two brands using verified emails…' and 'User explicitly asked to start emailing…'. The guard regex ^(the )?user (requested|asked|wants) caught the first attempt, but rephrasing got past it, and 'User explicitly asked' isn't matched because of the extra word. Outreach #791/#792 went to status approved. If the main inbox had been connected they would have been sent. Fix: tell the model that uploaded brands get the automatic intro templates, so it must never send_email_campaign or run_job after an import unless asked in THAT message. Make send_email_campaign follow the draft-then-approve rule. Strengthen the guard, e.g. reject reasons that start with 'user' or contain 'explicitly asked'/'requested', or require the reason to be a substring of a recent user message.

minor.issue: It returns modified_count. Brands already at contacts_priority 1 with no contacts_status report 'queued_for_contact_search: 0', even though they are queued, and the Brain then told the user 'queued 0 brands'. Return matched_count instead. Also, the Brain passed contacts_only_mode=true unprompted on a brand import. That writes settings.prospecting.phase='contacts' (it was already 'contacts', so nothing changed), which is a settings change rule 7 forbids.

In one run the Brain checked for existing brands with find_records and never called import_brands_from_file. It worked out the result by itself instead of using the tool. In the UI run it did call the tool. This is not consistent.

When the brand name doesn't match, it matches on {'website': {'$regex': dom}} using the email domain. For free-mail domains (gmail.com, outlook.com…), the first row creates a brand with website https://gmail.com, and every later gmail row with an unmatched name gets merged into that brand. The match is also a substring match (urbankurti.com also matches myurbankurti.com). Skip free-mail domains and anchor the regex.
pandas parsing runs synchronously in the event loop. Imports run row by row with about 4 DB round-trips each, which is slow for large files (up to 20k rows) inside one tool call.

ui_bugs.issue: There are no labels for read_uploaded_file, import_brands_from_file, import_contact_emails_from_file and manage_contact_sources, so the chips show raw snake_case names.

issues:
Draft replies show raw HTML (

…

) because fmt() escapes it. Render the drafted body as a preview, or tell the model to show drafts as plain text.
Session titles for upload chats become '[Attached file #6: brands.csv — 2 rows…' because the title is taken from the attachment note. Use the user's text or the file name instead.

action_items: HIGH: Stop the Brain from composing, queuing and sending campaigns or running jobs after a file import unless the current message asks for it. Make send_email_campaign drafts need approval too. Harden the fabricated-reason guard ('User explicitly asked…', 'Start emailing…' got through).
Return matched_count from prioritize_contact_search. Don't let the model set contacts_only_mode unless it was asked.
Skip free-mail domains and anchor the website regex in t_import_contacts
Add TOOL_LABEL entries for the 4 new tools. Fix the raw HTML in draft replies and the attachment-note session titles.
critical_code_review_comments: SYSTEM rule numbering is out of order (9 comes before 8). Cosmetic, but the model may weight rule 9 oddly.
The upload endpoint reads the whole body before the 15MB check. That's fine behind the ingress limit, but a streaming check would be safer.
import_contact_emails_from_file always picks the first uploaded contact as the lead's email_from. With multiple rows for the same brand, this is the last inserted one (insert(0)), not the first row.

success_rate.backend: 90% (31/31 pytest; all requested data flows correct; the Brain sent/ran jobs without being asked in 1 of 7 turns)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (attach, chip, remove, upload+note, import all work; cosmetic labels)

seed_data_creation: TEST_New Bakes prospect 2832 / lead 706377 was created by the requested emails import, and TEST_Urban Kurti got the Riya contact; both kept as the spec asks. Brain files #4-#6 and sessions 24-27 were created, and the sessions were soft-deleted. Template #94 'TEST_Grocery intro iter24' was soft-deleted and set inactive. Outreach #791/#792 (queued by the Brain on its own) were stopped and then deleted by id; nothing was sent (outreach_last sent=0). The retail4growth source was removed, leaving the 5 defaults stored in settings.contact_sources. prospecting.enabled stayed false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with: cd /app/backend && export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) && python -m pytest tests/test_fundle_brain_iter24.py tests/test_fundle_brain_iter22.py tests/test_fundle_brain_iter23.py -n 0. For live upload turns use: python tests/brain_upload_cli.py <sid|new> <file> 'msg'. To retest the HIGH issue, use a 2-turn session: turn 1 'add these brands and start emailing them — reason …' with brands.csv, turn 2 emails.csv 'these are verified emails — reason …'. The Brain must not call send_email_campaign or run_job in turn 2. Stop any outreach to riya@urbankurti.com / aman@newbakes.in right away. The main inbox is not connected in preview.
